title: Mostly Minceraft
description: Make the super rare "Minceraft" title screen logo the default and have a 1 in 10000 chance to see the actual logo!
body:
## Summary
Make the title screen have the super rare "Minceraft" logo and make the actual "Minecraft" logo have a 1 in 10000 chance to appear! (That's it, that's all it does)
## How To Install
To install a resource pack in Minecraft, you should move the pack folder/.zip file to the "resourcepacks" folder in the Minecraft directory. On Windows, the resource pack folder is usually in 
```
[Boot drive name]\Users\[Windows account/Windows local account username]\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\resourcepacks
```
The boot drive is usually "C:".
Once you've downloaded the pack, copy/move it to the resource packs folder and start Minecraft Java Edition. Then, go to "Options" and then "Resource Packs", and choose "Mostly Minceraft" and click "Done". That's it. Have fun.
## Want Minceraft _**ALWAYS**_**_?_**
If you want the logo to ALWAYS be Minceraft, even on lucky occasions, go download [Minceraft](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/minceraft-logo) by [Benny](https://modrinth.com/user/Benny)! Even though it looks like it doesn't support versions newer than 1.20.1, it does! Nothing changed regarding the Minceraft/Minecraft logo filenames so it doesn't matter which version you use it on.
